title: BrowserAct
summary: Web browser automation for AI agents
content: BrowserAct: Web browser automation for AI agents | Product Hunt Launching today BrowserAct Launching today Web browser automation for AI agents 988 followers Web browser automation for AI agents 988 followers Visit website Automation tools • Browser Automation BrowserAct is built for agents using the web. It gives agents a browser layer for real websites, so they can pass blocked pages, adapt to real scenarios, run multiple tasks safely, and return clean web data for reasoning. Use BrowserAct when an agent needs to browse, click, extract, fill forms, upload files, work inside logged-in sites, handle verification, or run repeatable browser workflows. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team Awards More Free Launch tags: Productivity • Artificial Intelligence • GitHub Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 1 Day Rank Upvote • 449 points Follow BrowserAct Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info browseract.com GitHub BrowserAct Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/browseract Similar Products Browser Use Make websites accessible for agents 5.0 ( 15 reviews ) Browser Automation Browserbase Give your agents access to the whole web. 5.0 ( 13 reviews ) Browser Automation Firecrawl The Web Data API for AI Agents and Developers 5.0 ( 14 reviews ) Browser Automation LLM Developer Tools Airtop Automate your work with just words 4.7 ( 7 reviews ) Automation tools AI Workflow Automation Skyvern Open Source Browser Automation Company 5.0 ( 7 reviews ) No-code Platforms Automation tools View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Viktor.com The AI employee that does the work, in Slack & Teams Try Viktor.com Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Wendy BrowserAct Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Wendy , Senior Marketing Operations at BrowserAct . AI agents work well in clean demos, but the real web is messy: login state, verification, dynamic pages, uploads, blocked flows, and browser sessions that interfere with each other. Most agents stop the moment a website pushes back. So we built a browser layer that doesn't. BrowserAct reads the messy parts of the web your agent can't handle alone. It's an It's an browser automation CLI that keeps session state, works through common web blocks, hands off to a human when needed, and returns clean web data for reasoning . The idea is simple: agents should automate what they can, ask for help when they're stuck, and continue from the same browser state afterward. You stay in control of all of it; nothing runs without your sign-off. 🎁 For Product Hunt: Get a free 7-day trial to test BrowserAct on a real browser workflow your agent keeps breaking on, no code needed. Here all day, and would love your honest feedback. What browser task still breaks your agent today? title: Polygraph
summary: Let AI agents see cross repo and maintain session memory.
content: Polygraph: Let AI agents see cross repo and maintain session memory. | Product Hunt Launching today Polygraph Launching today Let AI agents see cross repo and maintain session memory. 5.0 • 9 reviews • 282 followers Let AI agents see cross repo and maintain session memory. 5.0 • 9 reviews • 282 followers Visit website AI Coding Agents AI coding agents are limited to how autonomously they can work because they have no model of the codebase as a whole. Polygraph is a meta-harness that gives agents what they're missing: Visibility across every repo boundary and memory that survives the session. Connect all your repos, private and public, into a unified dependency graph without moving any code. Resume, reference or build on any session created by any developer, on another machine, even on different agents. Overview Reviews 9 Alternatives Customers Built with Team More Free Launch tags: Developer Tools • Artificial Intelligence • Tech Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 8 Day Rank Upvote • 147 points Follow Polygraph Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info trypolygraph.com Polygraph Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/polygraph Similar Products Claude Code Anthropic’s deep-context AI coder 5.0 ( 535 reviews ) AI Coding Agents Command line tools Codex 3.0 by OpenAI Codex can now build, test & debug on autopilot 5.0 ( 36 reviews ) AI Coding Agents Command line tools Kilo Code The open-source agentic engineering platform 5.0 ( 44 reviews ) AI Coding Agents AI Code Editors Google Antigravity Run and monitor several coding agents at once in an IDE 4.5 ( 17 reviews ) AI Coding Agents AI Code Editors opencode Your terminal's AI agent, with any model you want 5.0 ( 28 reviews ) AI Coding Agents Command line tools View more Subscribe Sign in Social X Framer 3.0 With Agents, Branching Community and an all-new design Try Framer 3.0 Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Heidi Grutter Polygraph Maker 📌 Our founders, Jeff Cross and Victor Savkin, have been building monorepo tooling for over a decade. In the last few years we've noticed that the ergonomics of monorepos have been especially great with AI agents. All your code visible in one place, allowing you or your agents to quickly see the full context it needs to make decisions that won't break your CI when it comes time to merge. We wanted to bring this to the whole developer tooling community because we know even if some teams use monorepos, it's not realistic to have an entire org on one (unless you're Google.) It started by building a dependency graph - a sort of synthetic monorepo - and then we had to tackle agentic amnesia. Agents are great, but having to re-explain yourself or losing context sucks. Like a game of telephone, it's never the same as being able to stay in session. We built Polygraph for: Individual devs : If you're deep in a feature that touches 3 repos, Polygraph will set up all 3 in a single session, manage CI across them, and keep a record of everything

content: Paybond: Safe spend controls for AI agents | Product Hunt Paybond Safe spend controls for AI agents 65 followers Safe spend controls for AI agents 65 followers Visit website Engineering & Development • Finance • AI Agents Your AI can now buy tools, APIs, and services on its own. That’s useful — but risky without rules. Paybond is the safety layer in between: you set a budget, nothing gets spent without approval, Paybond checks the work actually got done, and you can get money back if it didn’t. Every approved spend is logged in one clear record your team can review later. Developers can get started in minutes with the Paybond CLI — log in, set guardrails, and connect a coding agent or MCP host from the terminal. Overview Launches 2 Reviews Alternatives Team More This is the 2nd launch from Paybond. View more Paybond CLI Launching today Safe agent spend from the terminal Visit Paybond CLI is new: one command line for safe AI agent spending, in TypeScript and Python. Run paybond login to get into sandbox in minutes. From there: scaffold paid-tool guardrails with paybond init, wire Claude, Codex, or any MCP host with paybond mcp install, and validate credentials and agent setup with paybond doctor. Every command supports JSON output for scripts and coding agents. Same rules everywhere: budgets, approval before spend, outcome checks, and audit-ready records.
